Lina Gomez: Quick thread on small UI/UX nits for the Compliance & Security section. Not urgent but want to capture before we ship. Priya Nair: Thanks Lina drop screenshots? Lina Gomez: Pasted a screenshot to the ticket PROD-4591 but capturing notes here too. Main things: retention copy, region naming, KMS field affordances, and a couple a11y fixes. Evan Brooks: I'll take KMS + audit log flow. Lina Gomez: 1) Retention selector shows numeric options only: `7`, `30`, `90`. Change to `7 days`, `30 days`, `90 days` and add microcopy under the control: `Measured from ingestion time (UTC).` Diego Ramos: Slightly different ask: for Dedicated customers we surface monthly billing implications when you pick >365 days. Can we show inline `Estimated extra monthly cost: $X`? Not required for hosted obviously. Priya Nair: Good point Diego. Maybe conditional help: `Estimated cost shown for Dedicated plans`. Keep it muted text. Lina Gomez: 2) Region naming: current options mix short codes and friendly names. Standardize to `EU (Frankfurt)`, `US (Ashburn)`, `APAC (Singapore)` instead of `eu-west-1` etc. Also add small tooltip: `Data residency applies to stored logs and backups.` Evan Brooks: For the region control keyboard handling is funky. When you open the list with Space it doesn't set focus to first option. Repro: Tab > Space to open > ArrowDown should highlight first. Currently it blurs. Add role=listbox + aria-activedescendant. Lina Gomez: 3) KMS input: the field currently is labeled `KMS` which confuses product folks. Suggested label: `Customer encryption key (KMS)` and helper `Leave blank to use Redwood-managed keys.` Evan Brooks: Add copy/paste affordance: show masked key with trailing characters e.g. `rwd-...-f3b2` and a copy icon. Provide `aria-label=\"Copy key id\"` and announce `Key copied` with aria-live. Priya Nair: Also expose a read-only link `View key details` that opens a modal describing who can access the key and rotation policy. That helps compliance reviewers. Diego Ramos: On the KMS modal, the current paragraph reads like legalese. Reword to: `Only admins with KMS access can read your key ID. Redwood never stores the private key.` Add a `Learn about KMS` link. Lina Gomez: 4) Audit Logs export: rename primary action from `Export` to `Download CSV` and move other destinations under a chevron menu `Send to...` with options `S3`, `Webhook`, `SIEM`. Also change date quick presets to `Last 24 hours`, `Last 7 days`. Evan Brooks: For the CSV filename, include org id and date range: `redwood-1234-audit-20260101-20260107.csv`. Some customers asked for that. Priya Nair: Accessibility nits: contrast on the muted inline links is too low on dark theme. Use 4.5:1 AA minimum. Also KMS input missing label element for screen readers. Lina Gomez: Add acceptance criteria for the PR: 1) retention unit text + UTC help, 2) standardized region naming + tooltip, 3) KMS label + masked key + copy affordance + modal, 4) audit logs primary action renamed + export menu, 5) dark-theme contrast fixes, 6) keyboard/ARIA fixes for region and KMS inputs. Include axe baseline in CI. Diego Ramos: Localization note: when changing copy for `Customer encryption key (KMS)` we need short and long variants for narrow languages. I'll add translation notes. Evan Brooks: I'll attach a minimal code snippet for aria on region: `
  • EU (Frankfurt)
` Priya Nair: Tiny UI thing: the retention warning chip currently uses orange on orange, which is hard to parse. Consider outline or icon + text. Lina Gomez: Great. I'll create a design PR with copy patches and mockups, tag eng for the a11y fixes, and add Diego for Dedicated pricing callouts. Thanks all :white_check_mark: design-bot: Auto note design file updated in Figma: PROD-4591 (Lina Gomez) at 1766305900.
